Privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Children's Privacy Notice
Privacy.version: Version {version} · Children's Privacy Notice (what parents agree to): version {childVersion}
Privacy.intro: This policy covers families who use Spirit of Santa and visitors who thank a child, give a tip or donation, or ask for a pay-later text. It includes our Children's Privacy Notice. Spirit of Santa lets children earn Christmas Magic for good deeds and spend it on a Christmas wish list. Children never create their own accounts: a parent or guardian sets everything up and stays in control.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body:
From you (the parent): your name, email address, a password (stored only in scrambled form), a private family name and, if you choose, your ZIP code.
About each child, entered by you: a first name, birth year and a display name you choose; the good deeds you record; their Christmas Magic and wish list.
Only when one of your children's gifts is funded: a delivery address for the gift (stored encrypted).

public.title: What others can see
public.body: When someone scans your child's QR code, they see only the display name you chose (for example "M."), the deed, and your family nickname if you switch that on. Never your child's full name, age, town or photo. People who say thank you can only pick one of a few ready-made thank-you notes (never their own words), and your child sees a note only after you approve it.

share.title: Who we share information with
share.body: Stores only ever see totals (for example "on 12 wish lists"), never which children chose an item. Card payments are handled by Stripe; we never see or store card numbers. Emails are sent by our email provider. We don't sell information and don't show ads. Pay-later text messages are delivered by our messaging provider (Twilio), only to send the message you asked for.

consent.title: Your consent
consent.body: You agree to this notice when you create your account and confirm your email. Each child is then registered with a $5 card payment, which confirms that a parent or guardian is giving consent.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: At any time you can see, correct or delete your child's information, or stop us collecting more, from your parent dashboard or by contacting us. Deleting a child removes their information.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.body:
Christmas Magic resets every January 1. We keep your family's information while your account is open, and delete a child's information when you ask us to.
Visitors: donation receipt details are kept as the charity's records; a pay-later mobile number and the time you agreed are kept up to 13 months, then deleted.
A delivery address is deleted automatically as soon as every funded gift has been delivered; you can delete it yourself at any time.
If you delete your account while a paid gift is on its way, you can choose to receive it first: we then delete your children's information right away and keep only your email, family name and delivery address until it arrives (gifts ship in December; at the latest January 31 after that Christmas), then delete those too.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions or requests: contact details will be added here before launch.

visitors.title: Tips and donations from visitors
visitors.body: If you scan a QR code to thank a child or give a tip or donation, card payments are handled by Stripe; we never see your card number. For donations we keep the name and email you type in Stripe's form so we can send your receipt.

texts.title: Text messages
texts.body: If you choose "Pay later by text", we use the mobile number you type to send you one text message with a payment link for the tip you chose. We send only that message for that request, never marketing. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Texts are delivered by our messaging provider (Twilio) only to send your message. Your mobile number and consent are not shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. We keep the number and the time you agreed for up to 13 months as a record of your consent, then delete it.

TextMessages.title: Text messages from Spirit of Santa
TextMessages.intro: We send one kind of text message: a link to pay a tip later, only when you ask for it.

how.title: How you sign up
how.body: When a child does a good deed for you, you can scan the deed's QR code. On that page you may choose "Pay later by text", type your own mobile number and tick the box agreeing to receive the text. The box is never ticked for you, and the text can't be requested without it.

what.title: What we send
what.body: Exactly one text message for each request: a secure payment link for the tip you chose. The link expires after {days} days. We never send marketing or other messages.

frequency.title: How often
frequency.body: One message per request. If you don't ask again, you won't hear from us again. Message and data rates may apply.

stop.title: Stop or get help
stop.body: Reply STOP to stop all texts from us, or HELP for help. You can reply START to receive them again.

privacy.title: Your number
privacy.body: We use your number only to send the message you asked for. Your mobile number and consent are never shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

TextMessages.formIntro: This is the form you will see:

about.title: About Spirit of Santa
about.body: Spirit of Santa is a program where children earn Christmas Magic for good deeds and use it toward Christmas gifts from local stores. By using spiritofsanta.com you agree to these terms.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Only adults can create an account. A parent or guardian sets up and controls each child's profile; children never have their own accounts. Keep your password and parent PIN private.

points.title: Christmas Magic
points.body: Christmas Magic is calculated by Spirit of Santa from money actually received (currently {rate} = 1 Christmas Magic). Christmas Magic has no cash value, can't be exchanged for money and resets to zero every January 1.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Tips, bonuses, registrations and donations are processed by Stripe. All payments are final: we don't offer refunds, except where the law or your card network requires it (for example a disputed charge).

donations.title: Community donations
donations.body: Gifts on our donation page are pooled and shared equally among registered children when the season freezes (December 1). A platform fee, shown on the donation page before you give, supports running Spirit of Santa.

season.title: The season and gifts
season.body:
Spirit of Santa runs all year: Christmas Magic can be earned from January 1. On December 1 (the freeze date; the site shows the current date) wish lists freeze and giving (tips, donation links and bonus magic) closes, so every gift can arrive by Christmas; parents can then finish unfinished gifts for three days after community donations are shared. Gifts still unfinished after that drop off, and the Christmas Magic on them goes to Spirit of Santa.
A gift is secured as soon as it is fully funded: it can no longer be removed, its Christmas Magic is used for it, and the store keeps it for your child until it ships in December.
The site is closed after Christmas (from December 26) and opens again on January 1.

texts.title: Text messages (pay later)
texts.body: Program: Spirit of Santa pay-later tip links. If you choose "Pay later by text" and agree, we send you one text message with a secure payment link for the tip you chose; the link expires after {days} days. One message per request; no marketing. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out at any time, or HELP for help. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. See our Privacy Policy for how we handle your number.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Don't misuse the site, other people's QR codes or payment links, and don't enter information about anyone without permission.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms. The version and date at the top show the current terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions: contact details will be added here before launch.
